verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents a full REST API for interacting with the application. The docs name specific endpoints, including toggling flags from deploy scripts and pulling experiment results, and the official MCP server is built on that REST API. A hands-on probe also created a user, an organization and a feature through the API on a self-hosted instance. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and fuller evidence of the endpoint catalog and authentication model.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: GrowthBook offers a full REST API for interacting with the application.
automate it (for example, from a deploy script) with the toggle feature endpoint, which switches a flag on or off in one or more environments.
Get results for an experiment (`GET /v1/experiments/{id}/results`) to pull the latest analysis into your own reporting.
the first user and organization were created through the API, a boolean feature `pa-probe-flag` was created
